title: Mixed Event — Mermaid Admiration — Episode2 The Memorable Mermaid

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has begun working as ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland. Their first visit will be to an outdoor stage on a beach. Hearing this, Nene remembers the performance of "The Little Mermaid" that she saw when she was little...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: What a wonderful sight to behold. Such beautiful corals and so many adorable fish.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Yet I still long for him.
The man I met during that storm...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: But if I wish to meet him, I must go on land... The thought alone terrifies me...

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (Going on land must be really scary for her since she's lived in the ocean her whole life...)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (It's like when we moved into our new house. That was really scary for me too...)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (Rui said he'd be my friend, but I'm not sure the other kids at school will...)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (Going to a new school's really scary too...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: No, I mustn't let my fears get the better of me...

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Diving into an unknown world is terrifying, but not being able to because of my own fears would be much worse!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: 'I'm going! I need to see him...!

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line:
(Her voice...
It's so pretty...)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (My heart won't stop pounding...!)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hearing the Little Mermaid sing made me want to start doing plays and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember how you were always reciting her lines, Nene. It's very nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you really surprised me when you started conversing with guppies in the river as part of reenacting that scene where she speaks with the fish.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You don't need to talk about that...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
What a wonderful story! Such childlike wonder!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally get it! Everybody wanted to talk to fishies and animals when they were little!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Anyway, that show's what led me to acting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After that, I even went to see some other shows starring that actress.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Really?
Do you happen to remember her name?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, her name's Yuka Kazamatsuri.
She usually does musicals most of the time, but I might've seen her on TV first.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, I think I've heard of her!
She's in a theatre company overseas, right...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. She lives in the United States now and has been performing in shows all around the world.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Unfortunately, you don't get to see her in Japan much anymore...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But she's scheduled to come back this year, so I'm really looking forward to seeing her again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's very exciting news.
Hold on... Isn't she supposed to perform at a venue near the Otori resort?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Does that mean we can all go see Nene's hero together?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's a great idea!
I'm sure it'll be okay as long as it doesn't interfere with our work as ambassadorial duties.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That'd be nice but...
She isn't scheduled to perform until after we're gone, so I don't think we'll be able to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww... Really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you know what, Nene, I feel like we should choose the Little Mermaid after hearing your story!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After just that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm with her as well. It's the perfect show for a stage by the sea!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. We even have access to a romantic beach that can serve as the stage for when the Little Mermaid meets her man.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then the Little Mermaid it is! Wait, oh no!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What is it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In the fairytale version, isn't the Little Mermaid supposed to pass away in the end...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True... That means it's technically a tragedy, which would be the opposite of what we should be performing as ambassadors...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't we simply pay homage to the Little Mermaid...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Pay homage to her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We can think of a new story that's based on the Little Mermaid we all know and love.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Since it's so famous, we should be able to make adjustments to it rather easily while still being accessible to any children that may be in the audience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds fantastic!
Even those that come and join partway through should be able to understand what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I appreciate your enthusiasm.
So, Nene, how about it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't say that we absolutely have to do the Little Mermaid or anything...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But... Thanks...
I'd like it if we did that too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then it's settled!
For our first shows as ambassadors, we'll be paying homage to the Little Mermaid!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The Little Mermaid, with this troupe...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can't wait to get started.)
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you're paying homage to the Little Mermaid, it may be good to include a scene such as this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would make for quite the twist! I'll be sure to consider it, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, if I were the Little Mermaid, I might flap around on the beach like a fish the first time I come ashore!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's a mermaid! Not a fish!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The script's done!
It has to be one of Rui's best works yet! It even includes quite a few of your guys' suggestions!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Lemme see...!
Oh, wow! It's a super happy Little Mermaid story!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so different from what I'm used to and might even have a little too much going on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I think this is just the kind of show we were looking for.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then let's get to work and give it everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And so, the Little Mermaid and her friends all lived happily ever after!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: The end!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bravo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That was such a cute story!
It was so fun and exciting too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! Once again, we shall be performing a show worthy of a future star such as myself!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of you, that was a flawless rehearsal. I'm sure we'll be able to turn that beach into something very special.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope everybody that comes and visits the beach has lots and lots of fun♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, this is incredible! I can't figure out how you went from the Little Mermaid to this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I've never seen a rendition of the Little Mermaid before that was this happy and fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure the audience will enjoy it very much and don't forget to break a leg!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
I'm glad we asked you guys for suggestions.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um, Luka, what if we also tried performing the Little Mermaid☆ I bet it'd be a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think so too. Especially since mermaids can just glide so gracefully through the water. It must be such a wonderful sensation.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just thinking about that is making me... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hey, Luka!
Wake up!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Huh?
Oh, MEIKO, good morning♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you'll be performing by the sea, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We're scheduled to perform on a stage by the sea owned by a seaside resort.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A white, sandy beach... The soft sound of waves... And the sun glimmering in the sky...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It must be such a relaxing place.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha. I'm sure it is.
However, they won't be there to vacation.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, but if you do get a chance to look around, would you mind showing me what it's like...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The first two days are supposed to be the busiest, but we might be able to squeeze in from free time while we're cleaning up on the night of the third day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Really?
Thank you so much♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good for you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, are you all packed for tomorrow...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, not yet.
We should get home and do that right away.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, let's give it our best shot.
The next day
Beach

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa... It's beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it really is.
The sea air has such a nice aroma to it as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!! It's the ocean!!
Ocean!! Ocean!! Ocean!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, you're happy to be here! We get it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, weren't you just at the Seaside School not long ago with Saki and everyone else?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It was all pretty and sparkly and super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it's more sparkly and exciting when I'm with you guys because I know it's gonna be a super wonderhoy carnival...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. You're exaggerating...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that must be the stage. Excellent, it looks just like the illustration.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we start unpacking our props and equipment? We're going live just after our morning rehearsal, so we'll need to work quickly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah!
